subject: HelioCare: operational evidence and DPA amendment for no-training commitment
messages:
From: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@heliocare.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: HelioCare Legal <contract@heliocare.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: no-training commitment + operational evidence

Connor —

Thanks for the demo last week. Our legal and security teams have a couple of follow-ups before we can sign the DPA amendment: specifically we need a clear no-training (no model improvement) commitment for tenant data, a list of subprocessors with locations, and operational evidence showing data handling controls (KV/ephemeral caching, retention, deletion).

Can you confirm whether Redwood will sign a DPA amendment with explicit no-training language, and provide an evidence pack (logs, attestations, subprocessor inventory)? Also need to know if we can route HelioCare traffic to an onshore KMS and whether export controls are in place for EU/US transfers (we're US-based but have EU patients).

Appreciate a prioritized timeline — legal is aiming to finish procurement by end of month.

Thanks,
Sarah Lane
Head of Security Programs
HelioCare

Attachment: HelioCare_DPA_questions.pdf (pdf)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@heliocare.com>
Cc: HelioCare Legal <contract@heliocare.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-training commitment + operational evidence

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers up-front: yes, we can sign a DPA amendment with an explicit no-training clause for HelioCare tenant data; we can provide a subprocessor inventory and evidence artifacts; and we support onshore KMS routing for US-only keys.

Next steps from Redwood's side:
- Legal will prepare a DPA amendment draft with no-training and derivative-use language.
- Ops will assemble an evidence pack (logs, retention config, ephemeral KV description, sample audit entries).
- Tech will confirm KMS routing options and the steps for EU data residency if needed.

Looping in Kimberly and David to scope the evidence artifacts and timing. Target: initial evidence pack + DPA draft by EOD 2026-11-12. If that works, we can then set up a 30-minute call to walk through details.

—Connor
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@heliocare.com>
Cc: HelioCare Legal <contract@heliocare.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-training commitment + operational evidence

Sarah / team —

I'll scope the operational evidence. Quick technical clarifications I need to confirm with HelioCare so we deliver exactly what legal/security want:

1) No-training scope: confirm whether "no-training" must cover all downstream model improvement (no derivative-model training) or only excludes training on raw tenant prompt/response pairs. We typically surface both options in the amendment.

2) Data flow: do you expect SFTP export of captured interactions or a signed audit bundle? We can provide both but the format matters (SFTP export vs. time-limited Drive share vs. signed manifest).

3) KV/ephemeral retention: HelioCare wants specifics around prefix/KV caching retention and deletion. We'll include TTL configs, eviction logs, and an ops runbook snippet showing how deletion requests are executed.

4) Subprocessors: we'll attach the current inventory (with country) and note which subprocessors have access to persistent storage vs. ephemeral caches.

If you can confirm (1)-(3) by EOD today it will help us prioritize artifacts.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Privacy Ops
Redwood Inference

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@heliocare.com>
Cc: HelioCare Legal <contract@heliocare.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-training commitment + operational evidence

Team / Sarah —

We've packaged an initial evidence bundle and the subprocessor inventory as requested. Contents:
- subprocessor-inventory-20261110.csv (countries and access types)
- kv-eviction-log-sample.txt (timestamps + key-hash, redacted)
- retention-configs.txt (service-level TTLs and deletion APIs)
- operational-runbook-snippet.pdf (steps to submit and verify deletion)
- redwood-no-train-cert.txt (ops attestation of no-training enforcement for tenant-scoped routing)

I'll attach the bundle to this thread and upload to a restricted Drive folder; links below. We can also push an SFTP export if HelioCare prefers that delivery method for the evidence artifacts.

Note on KMS: we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) with onshore HSMs in AWS GovCloud and commercial regions. To route HelioCare traffic to an onshore KMS we need: (a) signed DPA amendment, (b) onboarding ticket with cloud account details, (c) KMS key-rotation policy accepted. Ops lead time: ~7 business days after onboarding ticket.

Attaching: redwood-no-train-evidence.zip

—David
Senior Product Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lane <sarah.lane@heliocare.com>, HelioCare Legal <contract@heliocare.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: no-training commitment + operational evidence

Sarah —

Thanks for the quick confirmations on scope earlier today. We've pushed the evidence pack to the shared link and attached the initial DPA amendment draft that includes: an explicit no-training clause (tenant data excluded from model improvement), a derivative-use prohibition, subprocessor controls, and an ops timeline for KMS routing.

What you'll find in the Drive folder:
- redwood-no-train-evidence.zip (audit artifacts and runbook snippets)
- subprocessor-inventory-20261110.csv
- dpa-amendment-draft.docx

Immediate asks for HelioCare:
1) Please confirm the exact no-training language you prefer (we provided two options in the draft).
2) Indicate whether you want evidence delivered via SFTP (we can provision a temporary bucket + manifest) or a time-limited Drive share.
3) If you want onshore KMS routing, confirm the contact for onboarding and we'll open the ticket.

If helpful, we can set a 30-minute review call tomorrow morning PT to walk the DPA draft and evidence artifacts line-by-line. Otherwise, we can route the DPA for signature via DocuSign once you confirm language.

DocuSign link (DPA amendment): https://app.docusign.com/transaction/ABC123456789
Drive evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_evidence_pack

Best,
